title: Fort Bragg Trailer Removal
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.MISSION INSTALLATION CONTRACTING COMMAND.419TH CSB.W6QM MICC FDO FT BRAGG
description_text: The Mission and Installation Contracting Command – Fort Bragg (MICC-FB) has a requirement for the 18th Airborne Corps. This is a non-personal service(s) contract to provide the removal of 4 modular office trailers consisting of 8 trailer beds from Fort Bragg Foundry Lot to off-post location. Site Visit: 01 April 2026 2-1731 Stiner Rd, Fort Bragg, NC 28307 at 10:00 am. Site Visit attendance is not mandatory. Submission: Quotes are due via email NLT 17 April 2026, 17:00 PM, EST. No telephonic quotes will be accepted. All quotes must be submitted to mitchell.h.collazo.mil@army.mil & francisco.j.nodamerly.mil@army.mil. Quotes MUST be good for ninety (90) calendar days after submission. Questions: Address all questions in writing to mitchell.h.collazo.mil@army.mil & francisco.j.nodamerly.mil@army.mil NLT 06 April 2026, 12 PM (NOON), EST. **Updated Combined Synopsis & Solicitation: Removed Addendum 52.212-4** **Questions and Answers added. Extended Quotes to 17 April 2026**
